name: player_id_mapping
description: Bridge table: our player_id <-> Big Balls Sports Data's bbs_player_id, one row per player. Matched by normalized name; same-name collisions on either side (e.g. two different players sharing a name across NBA history) are excluded rather than guessed at. Not every player matches - name variations across the two sources account for the gap.

name: bbs_player_id
description: This player's id in Big Balls Sports Data's system (UUID) - unrelated to our own numeric player_id.
logic: Matched by normalized name (diacritics/periods/whitespace stripped); name collisions on either side excluded rather than guessed at.

name: bbs_player_name
description: Player's name as Big Balls Sports Data spells it - the join key used to build this mapping.

name: bbs_team_id
description: This team's id in Big Balls Sports Data's system (UUID) - unrelated to our own numeric team_id.
logic: Matched by normalized full team name.
